input.value: Rear-ended at red light by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph without braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat

input.rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injury to policyholder; clearly an auto claim.

Vehicle is totaled (well above $25,000 loss threshold) and claimant has sustained injuries including whiplash and sprained wrist; requires prompt adjuster attention for vehicle assessment and injury documentation.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday morning at approximately 8:15am by another vehicle traveling at 35 mph without braking. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; the other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.
